text:
debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r a-c-c-e-s-s-e-d the l-o-g-i-n p-o-r-t-a-l of the b-u-i-l-d-i-n-g s-y-s-t-e-m using the a-d-m-i-n c-r-e-d-e-n-t-i-a-l-s, which left a s-e-s-s-i-o-n r-e-c-o-r-d as the only trace, and the m-u-l-t-i-f-a-c-t-o-r a-u-t-h-o-r-i-z-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k was the c-o-n-t-r-o-l that was b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d
2) the a-c-t-o-r i-n-j-e-c-t-e-d the m-a-l-i-c-i-o-u-s s-c-r-i-p-t into the t-o-u-c-h-s-c-r-e-e-n i-d e-n-r-o-l-l-m-e-n-t flow, which left a m-o-d-i-f-i-e-d d-a-t-a-b-a-s-e e-n-t-r-y as the only trace, and the d-a-t-a-b-a-s-e a-u-d-i-t l-o-g was the c-o-n-t-r-o-l that was b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d
3) the a-c-t-o-r u-p-l-o-a-d-e-d the f-a-k-e i-d e-n-t-i-t-y to the c-l-o-u-d d-i-r-e-c-t-o-r-y using the g-u-e-s-t a-c-c-e-s-s token, which left a f-i-l-e m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a e-n-t-r-y as the only trace, and the f-i-l-e v-a-l-i-d-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k was the c-o-n-t-r-o-l that was b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d
4) the a-c-t-o-r r-e-p-l-a-c-e-d the s-e-c-u-r-i-t-y c-a-m e-r-a l-o-g-s using the s-h-e-l-l a-c-c-e-s-s to the s-e-r-v-e-r, which left a t-i-m-e-s-t-a-m-p g-a-p in the f-i-l-e-s-y-s-t-e-m as the only trace, and the f-i-l-e-s-y-s-t-e-m i-n-t-e-g-r-i-t-y m-o-n-i-t-o-r was the c-o-n-t-r-o-l that was b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d
5) the a-c-t-o-r l-o-c-k-e-d the d-o-o-r s-c-a-n-n-e-r using the m-a-i-n-t-e-n-a-n-c-e m-o-d-e k-e-y, which left a h-a-r-d-w-a-r-e s-e-t-t-i-n-g c-h-a-n-g-e as the only trace, and the h-a-r-d-w-a-r-e a-c-c-e-s-s c-o-n-t-r-o-l was the c-o-n-t-r-o-l that was b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d
